description: A Perl script utility for flashing Fritz!Box devices, specifically for discovery and firmware upload procedures. It includes network communication, FTP interactions, and device control logic.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP customized for Adam2 device interactions, including command modifications for device-specific operations like environment variable fetching and reboot.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends USER command with upper case requirement for device FTP login.

methods.name: _PASV
methods.description: Enters passive mode with the device.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Fetches environment variables from the device via FTP commands.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to retrieve environment variables using _GETENV.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends reboot command to the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device by calling _REBOOT and closing FTP connection.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a flash check operation on the device.
